notes.title: Most Quietly v1.0
notes.content:
Most Quietly 1.0
 finally here! Game finally got an ending, some soundtracks was updated, bugfixes, and other...
Changed Music
 In some locations music was removed, and in some it was slowed down. But I didn't add 

new music.
Removed 2 characters
 Unfortunately, 2 main characters were removed. And with it, 1 boss fight was also removed.

But with it, game started to really feel scary, and like a horror game.
Small Improvemets
Small changes in the Ending text

Changed Pause menu

Added pixelization in the tutorial level and normal menu

Changed tutorial level

notes.title: Most Quietly 0.3.1
notes.content:
Improvements
Good and Evil endings replaced with one, True Ending

Added secret videos

Now, you don't need collect 10 books. Only fill your sound bar to win, in the location Library.
Bugfixes
Fixed bug where boss fight didn't stop on restarting the location.

notes.title: Most Quietly v0.3
notes.content:
New Endings
 Now the game has a two different endings: Good and Bad. So now, you can finally

beat the game!
New Locations
 The game now has a 2 new different locations: Field, and Calm City. They're has a completely opposite atmosphere, so be sure to see them!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/8f9e45bba43e2abd888231272cd95ee945abe441.png"]
Field
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f5872e7d9abcbd8877f07ec6fc8b5cb8112f2983.png"]
Calm CityNew Bosses
 Now game has 5 new bosses. They're all has a different boss themes, and way to beat them. So, the game became harder!
New Interface
 With this update, all interface was changed! Now it in hand-drawn style.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f92b872b2ae6883447a06ae0aeacea1a242fea9d.png"]
Inventory and 9 new items
 Other big feature of this update, is INVENTORY. It has 7 slots, but 1 slot can store only 1 item. Inventory needs some improvements, so it maybe will be improved in v0.4!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/f1c8d632e0de6ad63d351dbfb6f988be35148290.png"]

With inventory, was added 9 new items: Grilled Sandwich, Milk. Nut Bar, Soda, Peach Juice, Cooked Chicken, and a Coconut Bar. They're scattered in all locations. You surely will use them!
Small improvements:
Changed warning screen

Changed story in how to play menu

Play button was renamed to a Location Select button

Saves menu was replaced with Location Select menu

Changed logo

Changed dialogue in the tutorial level

Changed location library

Changed win screen

Added health system to the player

Added attack strength to the player

Changed pause menu

Changed location Dead library

Changed music

Changed bosses

Changed location Forest

Added puzzles to location Forest

Changed location Glitch City

Added 7 new songs

notes.title: Most Quietly v0.2
notes.content:
Different sound bar!

Now sound bar doesn't anymore have count, instead of count now bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438707/ddbca3b6a70c317abfc505fc9ae03e6fc543987d.png

Changed locations!
In the library the room with sink now removed. So now you can't get your sound very high, light of flashlight became lighter, and text in the developer book also changed. In the dead library, text in the start room now also changed. And in the forest, now you need to shoot boss by gun, instead of throwing trees.

More music and sounds!
In the menu and in the library, music now changed. Added sounds to throwing item, when boss getting hit, when boss teleports and throwing projectile.

Bugfixes

 In the dead library after defeating boss library no more too dark.
